verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll/HR SaaS, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows one: the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The help-center search endpoints in the citations belong to the help-desk host platform, not a Justworks product API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
